about-silken-thread.title: About Silken Thread
about-silken-thread.metaDescription: Silken thread is an independent organisation working with more than a 100 manufacturers and weavers across India to make authentic Indian textile products available online.

sections.title: About Silken Thread
sections.html:
Founded in 2022, SilkenThread.in connects you with the finest handwoven fabrics from across India. We 
source directly from over 3000 weavers, artisan communities, and self-help groups, ensuring fair wages and ethical practices. Our commitment to transparency allows you to trace the journey of your fabric, from loom to your hands. Discover the beauty and artistry of traditional Indian textiles. Support sustainable fashion. Experience the difference. 

We are not averse to selling blended silk and artificial silk products on this platform, but we believe in being transparent about fabrics used- not just as a safeguard against health scares, but also because we believe in obtaining a fair price to our customers and a fair pay for weavers. Our ultimate satisfaction lies in striking a balance between the two. Handloom, powerloom, handmade, blended or pure — we tell you exactly what you're buying. 

Wherever possible we partner with organisations like the Central Silk board to make sure that your handlooms are as authentic and pure as they can get- the QR coded silk tag in your shipment can help you to differentiate between pure natural silks and others.

We do hope you love our collections- do reach out to us via email, our social links or through the chat widget on our website. We would love to hear from you!
